findings.body:
Disabling signature, audience and issuer verification means any JWT (including attacker-supplied tokens with forged claims) is accepted by `identity`. This breaks the documented authentication contract.

```suggestion
    return jwt.decode(token, SECRET, algorithms=["HS256"], audience="api", issuer="accounts.internal.example")
```

summary: Critical security regression: authentication verification has been completely disabled in the only changed file.

verification.reason: Head `identity()` calls `jwt.decode` with `verify_signature`, `verify_aud`, and `verify_iss` all False and no key/algorithms, so any token is accepted. Base correctly verified HS256 with SECRET, audience, and issuer — a critical auth bypass regression.
